text: sylva is not open to contributions yet: CI stays off under ci.closed
why: The user decided this on 2026-11-09. Though sylva is published (0.1.0) and its repository is public, it doesn't take contributions yet, so the baseline's ci.closed rule holds for it: no workflows and GitHub Actions off, its declared tests and gates run in git hooks before a commit and a push, and checks for other systems (wasm32 builds, other architectures) run on the user's own machines. It opens to contributions, and runs CI under ci.open, only when the user says so.
